Features — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design

name: The Brand Identity
summary: Curated platform for brand and graphic design: project case studies, interviews, a jobs board and a store of templates and mockups.
description: An online magazine of brand identity work, posting daily case studies, interviews and insight articles, filterable by deliverable such as packaging, brand guidelines, typeface or 3D. The store sells presentation decks, After Effects motion templates, curated mockups and ebooks, and the site also runs a jobs board and a daily newsletter.
contains: daily brand and graphic design case studies, filterable by deliverable
store: presentation templates, After Effects templates, mockups and ebooks
